export_mechanics: Unlicensed shipment of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China
Failure to obtain required export licence for items controlled under 3B001
notes: Largest BIS civil penalty for semiconductor equipment to China as of date. Involved shipments routed through intermediaries. Populate from BIS press release and order.

export_mechanics: Deemed export violation — foreign national employees in US accessed controlled EDA software tools (ECCN 3D001/5D002)
Failure to obtain deemed-export licences for access to controlled technology
cyber_nexus: Foreign-national employee access to controlled design tools constitutes deemed export under EAR §734.13; internal access controls insufficient
notes: Investigation began 2024. Settlement terms: enhanced compliance programme, annual reporting. Key precedent: EDA software deemed export. Populate from BIS order.

Designated 56 US defence/semiconductor companies on Chinese Unreliable Entity List
notes: Bidirectional nature of export controls. Rare earth countermeasures created supply-chain vulnerability for US semiconductor industry. Populate from MOFCOM and US government responses.
